{{Top|leg}}
'''Red''' was a commentator on [[Gundark's Gear Datalog]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Red commented on the entry for the [[d'skar]], recommending that while the weapon was the easiest [[Ekkar Armaments]] to find off-world, the cost was usually four times the retail value. Red advised visiting the Ekkar Armaments site on [[Coyn]] and getting one directly from the manufacturer instead.<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>

Red also knew a contact based in the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]] who had a practical monopoly on [[black-powder pistol]]s. The contact scavenged them from an old battle site and fitted the pieces together. Red also noted that every weapons collector had at least one black-powder pistol gathering dust in their collection. Commenting on the entry for the [[Imperial Munitions/Legends|Imperial Munitions]] [[Imperial Munitions Heavy Blaster Pistol|Heavy Blaster Pistol]], Red noted that the weapon was going to be highly collectible due to it being the last product manufactured before the company went out of business.<ref name="GFT" />
